CLIMASTRA – Climate Strategy and Analytics is a new India-based environmental consultancy focused on providing innovative, science-based solutions to today’s evolving environmental and climate challenges. The company brings together expertise in hydrodynamic and hydraulic modeling, climate change assessment, pollution studies, remote sensing, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), and environmental analytics to support sustainable development and informed decision-making.
At CLIMASTRA, we recognize that environmental challenges are increasingly interconnected. Floods, water-resource constraints, pollution, changing climate conditions, ecosystem pressures, and rapid urban development require integrated approaches that combine scientific understanding with advanced analytical tools. Our work is therefore built around the integration of environmental science, numerical modeling, geospatial technologies, climate analytics, and data-driven approaches.
Our technical services include hydrodynamic and hydraulic modeling for rivers, drainage systems, floodplains, reservoirs, urban and coastal environments; climate change studies including climate-risk, vulnerability, impact, and adaptation assessments; and pollution and environmental studies focused on understanding environmental processes, pollutant pathways, impacts, and mitigation measures. Through remote sensing and GIS, we provide spatial analysis, environmental mapping, watershed and land-use assessments, monitoring, and decision-support solutions.
As a young and emerging consultancy, CLIMASTRA is designed to be agile, collaborative, and innovation-oriented. We aim to develop solutions that are technically rigorous while remaining practical, transparent, and responsive to the specific requirements of each project. Our approach emphasizes understanding the problem, selecting the right scientific and analytical methods, and translating complex environmental information into clear and actionable outcomes.
CLIMASTRA seeks to work with government agencies, infrastructure and development organizations, industries, research institutions, academic organizations, and other stakeholders to address environmental risks and build climate-resilient and sustainable systems.
Our vision is to establish CLIMASTRA as a trusted provider of climate, water, and environmental intelligence, helping organizations anticipate risks, understand environmental change, and make better decisions for a more resilient and sustainable future.

CLIMASTRA – turning climate and environmental data into insight, strategy, and action.
